about_description: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source Bitcoin education website founded in 2022. Our mission is to accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education.
about_page_description: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source Bitcoin education website founded in 2022. Our mission is to accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education.
about_mission_1b: in 2022 with a simple mission: accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education.
about_mission_2: We exist to be the first link you share with someone who is curious about Bitcoin. A friendly, accessible starting point that explains how Bitcoin is building a better world.
about_mission_3: Too many people misunderstand Bitcoin or have never been properly introduced to it. We want to change that by providing free, high-quality educational content that anyone can understand.
about_what_we_do_1: We create free educational content for Bitcoin newcomers. Our website covers topics like inflation, self-custody, wallets, the Lightning Network, and how Bitcoin compares to other assets and payment systems.
about_what_we_do_4: All of our content assumes zero prior Bitcoin knowledge. Whether you are brand new to Bitcoin or a seasoned Bitcoiner looking for resources to share, bitcoin.rocks is for you.
about_stickers_blurb: We mail free Bitcoin stickers to your door so you can help spread Bitcoin awareness in your community. Hundreds of people scan the QR codes on these stickers each month to learn about Bitcoin.
about_card_stickers_title: Get free Bitcoin stickers mailed to your door
about_flyers_blurb: We design printable flyers you can hand out at meetups, post on community boards, or drop in letterboxes — a simple way to spark curiosity and send people to bitcoin.rocks to learn more.
about_card_flyers_title: Download and print Bitcoin flyers for your community
about_business_blurb: We provide free business kits that make it easy to onboard local merchants to accept Bitcoin. Each kit includes printable materials explaining the benefits of accepting Bitcoin for their business.
about_card_business_title: Help local businesses accept Bitcoin payments
about_editorial_1: Every piece of content on bitcoin.rocks is curated and fact-checked. When we reference data or statistics, we cite our sources so you can verify the information yourself.
about_editorial_2: We link to trusted sources like the Federal Reserve (FRED), the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, the FDIC, the United Nations, the World Gold Council, Forbes, MIT Technology Review, Lyn Alden, and James Lavish. We believe Bitcoin speaks for itself when the facts are presented clearly.
about_editorial_3: Our content is regularly reviewed and updated to ensure accuracy and freshness. All content is focused exclusively on Bitcoin education.
about_open_source_2: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source project licensed under the MIT License. Anyone can contribute to bitcoin.rocks. We especially welcome translators who help make our content accessible to people around the world.
about_open_source_3: Thanks to our community of volunteer translators, bitcoin.rocks is currently available in 55 languages and growing.
about_card_contribute_title: Learn how to contribute to bitcoin.rocks
about_contact_1: We would love to hear from you. Whether you have a question, suggestion, or just want to say hello, reach out anytime.
